title: You think your mistakes disqualified you.
paragraphs:
You think your mistakes disqualified you.
God says your story isn’t finished.

The enemy loves to whisper:
“You failed too much.”
“You messed up too badly.”
“You’re not worthy anymore.”
But God specializes in using broken people.

The same grace that forgives you
is the grace that restores your purpose.

📖 “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.”
— 2 Corinthians 12:9

Your cracks don’t cancel your calling.
They may be the very place God lets His light shine through.
